g.title: cluster_ingestion_normalization_service
g.text: Ingestion and Normalization Service [Java / Spring Boot]

a.xlink:title: 08: Requests analysis of a chosen workflow run (REST/HTTPS)
07: Verifies the machine scope of a protected evidence capture (REST/HTTPS)
09: Records the admitted delivery as a durable receipt (in-process)
05: Persists admissions, workflow scopes and the capture/publication ledger (PostgreSQL)
02: Reads run metadata, jobs and logs with an installation token (GitHub API/HTTPS)
03: Reads GitHub App signing material (Azure Key Vault API/HTTPS)
10: Claims accepted receipts and freezes the publication plan (in-process)
11: Normalizes and protects the failed-run observation (in-process)
04: Publishes execution snapshots and protected evidence (Azure Service Bus)
12: Claims frozen outputs and confirms their publication (in-process)
